entity_raw.definition_raw:
You focus your ki in order to quell the influence of outside spirits on you.

Prerequisite(s): Ki pool class feature, still mind class feature.

Benefit(s): The saving throw bonus from your still mind class feature applies against possession effects, and as an immediate action you can spend 1 point from your ki pool to double the saving throw bonus provided by still mind.

Normal: Your still mind class feature applies only against enchantment spells and effects.
